nodes.question: Why is it important for the AVE values to exceed 0.50 in assessing convergent validity?
nodes.answer: It is important for the AVE values to exceed 0.50 in assessing convergent validity as it indicates that at least 50% of the variance in the indicators can be explained by the constructs they are intended to measure.
